body:
The first [conditional nominal-dose diagnostic](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/22241241daaae1b223d4ed6e0543f8fa1afcad9a/experiments/2026-10-25_1423_codex_dilution-dose-diagnostic/README.md) is complete, using the existing generic schema1 EvidenceStore recipe API. No additional source adapter or software release was needed. The [resolved recipe](https://github.com/pirl-unc/presto/blob/22241241daaae1b223d4ed6e0543f8fa1afcad9a/experiments/2026-10-25_1423_codex_dilution-dose-diagnostic/results/recipe-resolved.json) and complete source/metadata decisions are published.

- Preserve all90standard slots and the ten-member intended panel. Admit87positive exact-feature matches; exclude one positive with missing feature identity and two zeros. The tenth standard remains explicitly absent from the library, not a negative. Both DIA methods, nominal/grid conflict, filename-derived links and source-qualified material/protocol metadata remain intact.
- Five whole-dose development folds hold both methods together. Equal-group log-signal RMSE: **constant0.665914; fixed unit slope0.334620; learned shared slope0.340878; method slopes0.343272**. The shared-slope arm passes all four prespecified gates; the simpler fixed unit-slope control is preferred (49.75% lower error than constant).
- Independent admission replay reconstructs all90slots and87accepted IDs. Scalar replay verifies all24fits and696predictions, with maximum numerical error2.66e-14. All60required experiment artifacts verify from committed Git; executed sources and resource limits are unchanged.

This qualifies conditional nominal-dose sensitivity on the selected known-standard panel only. It does not estimate a new peptide's response offset or establish native/APC concentration, unconditional detection, extraction recovery or cross-protocol transfer. No independent test or RL advantage is claimed. There is no justification for adding model complexity on these nine standards.

The generic recipe is sufficient for this experiment. Broader amount/response anchors and transfer remain the concrete data need already tracked in #762; a reusable registered recipe/applicability entry for this selected panel can build on the linked, independently checked recipe. This comment does not close the broader applicability/recipe request prematurely.
